explanation: Coprolites show what extinct animals ate, from crushed bone to plant fibres. Gastroliths, by contrast, are stones some dinosaurs swallowed, perhaps to help grind food.

claims.text: Fossilized dung is called a coprolite.
A gastrolith is a stomach stone, an ichnite is a fossil footprint, and amber is fossilized tree resin.
Coprolites can reveal the diets of extinct animals, including bone fragments and plant material.
Some dinosaurs swallowed stones (gastroliths), possibly to help grind food.
